name: Jiangsu Zeyu Intelligent Power Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Zeyu Intelligent Power Co.,Ltd. engages in provision of engineering construction, operation and maintenance, system integration, and design and consulting services for the power industry in China. The company offers power communication system integration and power dispatch data integration services; network optimization and customized operation and maintenance services; and photovoltaic solutions and energy storage/microgrid services. It is also involved in consulting and designing of power distribution network and power grid; substation operation and maintenance monitoring system integration; telecommunications, power engineering, and power distribution automation construction.
